text: The retained working result A.4.55 proves a genuine multiplier-one parity-one survivor of the mixed-modulus-six five-point pentagon test. Root checked its complete finite kernel-containment proof and independently replayed its free-word certificate; the two possible boundary lifts are explicitly retained through their inner conjugation actions on the reconstructed orbifold quotient.
